card.name: Linking words in radiation dosimetry tables
card.fires_on: Small linking words and punctuation (of, the, to, parentheses) inside radiation dosimetry footnotes and tables, just before a word like dose or radiation is expected. It also fires on digits within dose-table numbers.

modes.label: Linking words in footnotes
modes.description: Words like of, the, to or an opening parenthesis in footnotes about effective dose calculation and weighting factors.
modes.example: c Radiation tissue weighting factors, w T , used in the calculation<< of>> effective dose are from 199

modes.label: Numbers in dose tables
modes.description: Digits or decimal points inside organ-dose values in radiation absorbed dose tables.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict dose, doses and radiation (including Chinese equivalents) as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in radiation dose tables and footnotes where the next word is likely to be dose or radiation.
